# ReSCom_Accelerator

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A reconfigurable spiking neural network accelerator that leverages stochastic computing to perform efficient spike-based computations with low hardware complexity. Provides a scalable and energy-efficient hardware platform for implementing SNNs in-network, enabling real-time neuromorphic processing at the edge.
